questions.question: At which ground did K Tjiane record their career-best innings (26*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2012/10/13.

questions.question: Shabnim Ismail's first and most recent appearances in this database are separated by roughly how many years?
